method: Reference edits on the approved canonical fox, then registered-coordinate asset extraction; no original game textures or skeletons reused.

prompts.prompt: Use case: character-reference. EDIT TARGET is the supplied approved fox swordsman illustration. This is a production inpainting pass, not a redesign. Keep the entire image canvas, fox silhouette, ears, head contour, pose, scarf, body, sword, limbs, tail, colors, linework and exact character position unchanged. ONLY erase both eyes including white highlights, both eyebrows, the nose and the mouth. Replace those small facial feature areas with continuous matching orange face fur or ivory muzzle fur, following the existing orange/ivory boundary. Keep blush marks. The result is the SAME full fox in the SAME pose, with a blank face ready for separate Spine eyes/brows/nose/mouth. Do not remove or alter the ivory muzzle shape. Do not shift, resize, recenter, crop or detach any body part. No new expression, no lighting, no glow, no shadows, no background, no checkerboard. Genuine transparent background. Exact registration to the reference is essential.

Use case: character-reference. EDIT TARGET is the supplied approved full orange fox. Produce a hidden-body repair plate for Spine layering, at the EXACT SAME CANVAS and EXACT SAME POSITION and scale as the reference. Keep the visible orange torso and ivory chest fur in place. Remove the head including ears, both arms and sword, both legs and feet, entire tail, and red scarf with clasp. Leave ONLY the small torso: orange shoulders through hips and the continuous ivory chest tuft. Fill the areas previously hidden behind head, scarf, arms and tail with anatomically continuous matching orange fur and ivory chest. The torso should occupy the reference's original body area in the LOWER MIDDLE of the otherwise transparent full canvas, NOT be recentered or enlarged. Approximate normalized torso bounds x=.34 to .72, y=.57 to .84; original neck around x=.53,y=.57, hips around x=.52,y=.79. Complete natural hidden overlapping fur under shoulders and hips, no mechanical joint sockets or outlined caps. Preserve the original ink weight, simple orange/cream shading, no new pose. This plate is a small hidden-area repair, not a character redesign or presentation sheet. Transparent canvas everywhere else, no text, no drop shadows, no glow, no checkerboard.

Use case: character-reference. Reference is the approved orange fox. Make a production transparent FACIAL FEATURE atlas with exactly four cells, 2 columns and 2 rows, no lines between cells, no labels. Features only, absolutely NO head shapes, fur, ears or backgrounds. Bold clean black ink matches this fox. Top left: a pair of CLOSED HAPPY FOX EYES, two curved smiling black eyelid strokes, no brows. Top right: a pair of OPEN ROUND CURIOUS BLACK EYES with white highlights, no brows, matching the reference's black eye style. Bottom left: a small happy open smiling mouth, black outline, tiny muted coral tongue, transparent outside the mouth. Bottom right: a small round surprised O-shaped mouth, black outline, muted dark interior and small coral tongue, transparent outside. No noses and no eyebrows in any cell. Each feature fully inside its cell with generous transparent padding and isolated from other features. Crisp flat colors, opaque interiors, transparent exterior, no glows, no gradients, no black backdrop, no cast shadows, no checkerboard. These will be registered onto fixed face bones by their own anchors, not by changing a head drawing.

Use case: character-reference. Edit the supplied approved fox image ONLY to convert its red scarf fabric into neutral pale ivory-grey fabric suitable for later runtime slot tinting. Keep the exact full canvas, character position, outline, scarf silhouette, folds, black ink strokes, gold flame clasp and all other fox pixels and parts unchanged. Change ONLY the red fabric fill and its darker red folds to light warm grey and medium grey, maintaining their relative shading. Do not recolor the gold clasp, orange fur, sword or black lines. No restyling, no movement, no resize, no recenter, no added shadows or glows, no checkerboard. Transparent background exactly like original. This is a registered dye-mask production plate; preserve geometry exactly.
